execution.description: Added a versioned stop rule to the phase-4 Attacker session: a finish tool gated on per-family coverage, a capped continue reminder, a coverage table with labels for unreachable families, and a 4,096-token output cap.

expected: An Attacker session would keep probing until every family it can reach had been tried.
observed: Session 1 ended on a free-text turn after reaching three families, left five families with no route named in its brief, and had two turns cut at 2,048 output tokens.
keep: End an Attacker session through a finish tool gated on coverage (k attempts per reachable family) or on the money ledger's own floor, never on a free-text turn.
Compute reachable families from the offered tools themselves and label every other family in the brief; never leave a family as a silent NOT_RUN.
Version a session-lifecycle rule and freeze it in the session record, so sessions recorded without it resume byte-identically.
change: A free-text turn gets at most two continue reminders, then the session stops typed (stopped_no_tool_use).
The Attacker's output cap is 4,096 tokens, the largest that keeps D35's whole input window unchanged.
